how_to_apply: Visit the GPSC OJAS application portal at gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
Open the advertisement corresponding to the post for which you want to apply.
Read the post name, advertisement number and detailed eligibility conditions carefully.
Click the online application option and enter the required personal, educational and experience details.
Upload your own recent photograph and signature in the prescribed format.
Review every entry and confirm the application before the deadline.
Pay the application fee, if applicable.
Download and retain a copy of the confirmed application form.

Only one application should be submitted for one advertisement. If a candidate submits more than one application, GPSC will consider the last confirmed application. For an unreserved candidate, the last confirmed application accompanied by the required fee will be considered valid.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Confirmed online application form; SSCE certificate showing the candidate’s date of birth; Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets; Experience certificates; Category certificate, where applicable; Non-Creamy Layer Certificate in the prescribed Gujarat format for SEBC candidates; EWS certificate in the prescribed Gujarat Government format; Disability certificate for applicants seeking PwBD reservation; Professional registration, licence or competency certificate required for the post; Recent photograph, signature and valid identity proof.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under GPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The combined notification announces 26 vacancies under Advertisement Numbers 42/2026-27 to 56/2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. When will the GPSC online application start?
faq.answer: The online application process will start on 24 September 2026 at 1:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit and confirm the online application is 8 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. Where can candidates apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through the GPSC OJAS portal at gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in.

faq.question: Q5. Which posts are included in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Marine Engineer, Engineer Surveyor, Port Officer, Assistant Port Officer, Traffic Officer, Safety Officer, Pilot Officer, Naval Architect, Manager, Assistant Director, Junior Architect and Joint Director of Horticulture posts.

faq.question: Q6. Are special vacancies available for persons with disabilities?
faq.answer: Yes. Nine posts are advertised under special recruitment drives for eligible persons with benchmark disabilities.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age-calculation date?
faq.answer: The candidate’s age will be calculated as on 8 October 2026. The post-wise age limits are available in the relevant detailed advertisement.
